_note: Repo-local pricing plan. Apify does NOT read this file: prices are entered in Apify Console > Publication > Monetization (actor.json has no pricing field - verified against the official actor.json schema in @apify/json_schemas). It exists so scripts can cross-check that every event the code charges is declared here, and that priceUsd >= 5 x estimatedCostUsd (CONVENTIONS.md, pricing rule). Dependency licence: @hebcal/core is GPL-2.0, allowed here only because this Actor runs as a private hosted service (never distributed) - see LICENSES.md.

date-converted.title: Date converted
date-converted.description: Charged once per input entry successfully converted (one dataset row with status "ok"). Blank entries and entries that could not be parsed are not charged.
date-converted.costBasis: Measured locally on 2026-09-29 with `node scripts/smoke-local.mjs hebrew-date-converter --measure`: 2-entry default input = 460ms wall / 101MB peak RSS = $6.39e-6/event; a 5,000-entry batch = 2.8s wall / 130MB peak RSS = $1.55e-8/event. At 256MB billed memory and an ASSUMED $0.40 per compute unit (unverified; CONVENTIONS.md SMOKE_CU_USD) the worst case is the smallest run (dominated by container start-up), rounded up to 7e-06. No paid external API, no network.
